findingEvidenceAnchors.status: coordinate anchors for source syntax only; cross-unit bindings and runtime remain unknown

ingress.managerEntry: Dfn.onNotification asserts active and attached threadExecution, clears pagination/observations/discovery on account reconnect-like events, and syntactically calls Vnn with this.notificationReductionContext.
ingress.constructorWiring: Dfn constructor creates notificationContext with bound manager updateTurnState, threadStore upsert, events/unread/itemStream/buffers; reductionContext captures manager:this, notificationContext and observation callback. Concrete manager/transport/storage instances are injected; external initializer/ingress is not resolved in this batch.
ingress.externalLinkLimit: Vnn, unn, Rnn, T7t, Ien and the other standalone definition units are source-pinned implementation candidates. Selected-unit parse proves their local parameter/declaration identities, but does not prove they bind each external same-spelled reference in Dfn or another unit.

routing.status: source syntax in Vnn candidate; cross-unit binding conditional
gates: shouldIgnore callback or follower mutation guard can short-circuit.
turn/started observation happens after these initial gates.
An external Etn predicate can take a special branch and emitNotification before the general switch.
routing.dispatch: General switch sends thread/started and thread/status/changed group to unn, turn/started/completed/error group to Rnn; deferred return skips final emitNotification.
routing.orderingLimit: This is source statement/guard order only. It does not prove actual event arrival order, race freedom, which branch executes, successful replay or delivery.

reductions.behavior: unn candidate calls notificationContext.upsertConversationFromThread(thread,"live"), records runtime status evidence and broadcasts a snapshot. T7t candidate upsert updates metadata of an existing conversation or creates one with turns:[] and resumeState:"needs_resume", then sets/notifies it. It does not directly hydrate all payload turns in this member.

Rnn candidate logs/breaks for missing conversation. Otherwise it selects a matching turn or a current inProgress placeholder, or constructs a turn; rebinds id/time, writes status/error from payload through the local callback and broadcasts a snapshot. A selected prior terminal turn causes callback return; helper identity remains an outer boundary.

Rnn first offers drainBefore a replay callback and returns deferred if true. Unknown conversation clears unread bookkeeping and logs. Interrupted/failed payload statuses clear terminal input buffers. A turn update writes id/status/error/duration/time and later conversation update sets notification decision/unread metadata; a snapshot is broadcast and non-follower branch emits turn-completed event. No actual status payload, invocation order or successful persistence was observed.

Rnn appends an error item containing message/willRetry/codexErrorInfo/additionalDetails. This branch contains no direct status=failed assignment. The surrounding store calls zB with no explicit status before mutation; zB candidate only changes status when its second argument is truthy. None of these separate-unit names establish an executed combined chain.

Dfn interruptConversationSelf supplies sendInterruptRequest and updateConversationState callbacks to Ien. Ien candidate checks expectedTurnId and an inProgress turn, awaits the request, and directly marks interrupted on success or selected recognized error/fallback branches. An interruption notification is not required by the syntax of that local success write. Promise success, error recognizers, turn selection and concrete callback identity remain unknown.

ownership.conversationStorage: T7t candidate declares conversations=new Map; get reads the Map and setConversation stores the new normalized state and drives subscriptions. Dfn conversations/getConversation delegate to threadStore.
ownership.updates: T7t candidate uses external pp or nie to produce changed state, then setConversation, notify callbacks and optionally emitConversationPatches; these third-party or helper implementations are not recovered here and their provenance is unknown.
ownership.activeTurn: Within selected Dfn/T7t scope, turn state is stored on conversation history/turns; the selected Dfn private #t method returns a ready result containing activeTurnId through B2t. B2t candidate delegates selection to mz/V2t.default and returns an id only when selected status is inProgress. _z is a separate canonical/history last-entry accessor. No standalone activeTurn ownership, complete consumer graph or external selector implementation is established.
ownership.liveVsPersisted: "live" in upsert denotes the literal passed to metadata/environment update; sV candidate handles environment evidence, not complete turn hydration. Runtime "live" reachability and disk persistence are not implied.

shownCalls: Dfn.updateConversationState writes changed searchMcpContext through injected storage.writeValue only for non-ephemeral conversation; changed hasUnreadTurn calls saveReadState.
saveReadState guards ownReadChange around injected readState.set in try/finally.
Dfn.setConversation reads/writes search metadata via injected storage on a feature-version branch.
T7t state mutations demonstrated here write a Map and emit/notify; whole-turn disk serialization is not established.
limits: storage/readState concrete implementations and their durability, format, atomicity, migration and upgrade behavior are not traced.
No claim that the whole app stores turns only in memory. Backend/server persistence, transcript hydration and other storage consumers remain outside the selected units.
Schema ephemeral/historyMode/path fields describe protocol declaration; no desktop persistence/restart result is inferred.

buffering.description: trn stores queued deliveries in a Map; release deletes its buffer then calls Xnn. kdn tracks pending starts/conversation IDs and replays via supplied callbacks with catch/log. rrn may discover/hydrate a missing durable conversation and then replay through manager.onNotification. Xnn candidate reconciles some hydrated text/delta/request records before callbacks.
buffering.limits: Helpers, timeout/retry schedule, hydration success, actual event order and race/recovery guarantees remain unknown. Function/class bodies do not prove external references select these definitions.

boundaries: External immutable-state helpers pp/nie and default-export utility calls remain opaque API boundaries.
Babel and host Node are analysis tools only, pinned as tool metadata and not copied.
Injected transport/storage/readState/runtime/scheduler interfaces are not presumed application or third-party ownership from a name.
thirdPartyBoundaries.provenance: unknown unless previously source-proven; no package/code recovery performed

nextDecisionChangingEvidence.text: A saved full-module lexical binding receipt for each Dfn/Vnn/unn/Rnn/T7t/Ien free reference and relevant writes could establish the candidate static links without name matching; this batch intentionally retains that boundary.
Exact inbound transport subscription/callback ownership and its manager-instance/host filtering should connect ingress to the entry method.

Trace injected storage/readState definitions and read hydration code in complete scopes to identify durable metadata versus turn history, while retaining actual restart/migration verification as pending.
A separately authorized one-task event trace would correlate arrival, buffering/drain, interruption, final status and UI; no such trace was submitted in this batch.

unknowns: No same-name cross-unit binding inference. Fragment Program ancestry is not original module-level proof.
Actual receiver/source ingress, externally injected instances, runtime branch/delivery, mode and full client feature coverage remain unknown.
Selected source statement order does not prove race freedom, successful buffering/replay or restart recovery.
No source/evidence from historical behavior is promoted to an actual current notification/UI test.

attemptHistory.failedAttemptReason: Exact-name declaration scout initially omitted async prefix and could not choose Ien; preserved failed source/stdout/stderr/exit. No target source execution occurred.
